capabilities.description: Phase 27 (Finding 1): the updater + relaunch + autostart permissions that are bound to plugins compiled OUT of the appstore build. Delivered HERE (inline, direct overlay) instead of capabilities/default.json so Tauri's capability codegen — which globs+validates every capabilities/*.json regardless of Cargo features — does not fail the appstore build with 'Permission updater:default not found'. Mirrors the Phase-26 iap:default delivery (26-05 §80-84), inverted for a direct-only grant. identifier + windows mirror default.json's shape VERBATIM so this capability actually ATTACHES to the main window at runtime (a malformed identifier/windows/permission would silently drop the grant — a direct-channel false-GREEN). The appstore build NEVER passes this --config, so it never references these permissions. NOTE the leading "default" reference above: Tauri's get_capabilities() (tauri-utils acl/mod.rs) uses the capabilities/ directory glob ONLY when app.security.capabilities is EMPTY — the moment this overlay sets a non-empty array, the active set is built EXCLUSIVELY from these entries, so without the explicit "default" reference the 12 baseline default.json grants (core:window/clipboard/store/global-shortcut/window-state/opener) would be DROPPED from the direct build (it would launch but deny core IPC at runtime). The string "default" is a CapabilityEntry::Reference that re-pulls the globbed default.json by identifier.
